title: SceneScriptV2
description: Canonical v2 scene card (TECH-SPEC-STORY-GAMES-100PCT §2.1). One card per stored kids_scene_scripts row. Canonical fields use `type`/`text`/`id`; legacy AI-generated cards used `sceneType`/`sceneId`/`narrationText` — tolerated as aliases and normalized by the frontend normalizer. Storage stays verbatim (pass-through).

id.description: Canonical card id/ordinal (optional — rows get their own uuid)

image.description: Scene image URL/asset key (real art; emoji fallback chain applies client-side)

background.description: Key into the approved background library, e.g. farm-daytime

emoji.description: Emoji fallback when no image/rig art

rigId.description: Key into the approved character rig library, e.g. buddy-the-fox

narrationAudio.description: Pre-recorded narration; when absent the client speaks `text` via TTS

gameId.description: Required when type/sceneType = game_checkpoint — the lesson id of the embedded game (a lesson that has a game config)
